sql: select 1 as sec, to_char(o.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') t, o.strategy_tag, o.ticker, o.side, o.count, o.status::text from orders o where o.strategy_tag like 'limm%' or o.strategy_tag like 'alimm%' union all select 2, to_char(p.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'pos', p.ticker, p.side, p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'') from positions p where (p.strategy_tag like 'limm%' or p.strategy_tag like 'alimm%') and p.quantity <> 0 union all select 3, to_char(b.at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'ledger', b.balance_cents::text, b.residual_cents::text, b.fills_counted::text, coalesce(b.notes_json::text,'null') from incentive_balance_observations b order by 1, 2 desc limit 40
